hero.name: Arshad Ali.
hero.paragraph:
Experienced in building robust, scalable web applications using Python, Django and modern tools like Docker and PostgreSQL. I strive to merge solid backend development with intelligent systems, aiming to create impactful, AI-enhanced solutions.

Driven by innovation and a passion for clean, efficient code, I focus on developing solutions that are both functional and forward-thinking.

paragraphs: Hello, I'm Arshad Ali — a Python developer specializing in Backend Engineering and Django, REST API, with expertise in Python, SQL, Django, and Docker. Since May 2023, I've been building scalable systems and exploring Django technologies through project-based learning.

Key projects include a real-time Gaming application, chatbots, an E-commerce store, Pharmacy POS, an App store, a Blog app, Social media chat, and Django task management apps. I've faced challenges in deployment and migrating local databases to other database platforms — experiences that drive me to enhance my skills in database technologies and backend API development.

I am seeking opportunities in Python and Django Backend Development where I can leverage my skills and advance my expertise in APIs, REST API, and FastAPI. Driven by a passion for overcoming challenges, I aim to make significant contributions to projects that inspire innovation.
